proof_body:
by
  intro f a b hf
  have hd : Differentiable ℝ f := hf.differentiable two_ne_zero
  have hf' : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) := hf.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  have hd2 : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) := hf'.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have h1 : ∀ x y : ℝ, deriv (fun s : ℝ => f (x, s)) y = fderiv ℝ f (x, y) (0, 1) := fun x y =>
    (HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (f := fun s : ℝ => (x, s)) y (hd (x, y)).hasFDerivAt
      ((hasDerivAt_const y x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id y))).deriv
  have h2 : ∀ x y : ℝ, deriv (fun s : ℝ => f (s, y)) x = fderiv ℝ f (x, y) (1, 0) := fun x y =>
    (HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (f := fun s : ℝ => (s, y)) x (hd (x, y)).hasFDerivAt
      ((hasDerivAt_id x).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const x y))).deriv
  simp only [h1, h2]
  have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (x, b)) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (a, b) (1, 0)) a :=
    HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (f := fun s : ℝ => (s, b)) a (hd2 (a, b)).hasFDerivAt
      ((hasDerivAt_id a).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const a b))
  have h4 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (a, y)) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (a, b) (0, 1)) b :=
    HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (f := fun s : ℝ => (a, s)) b (hd2 (a, b)).hasFDerivAt
      ((hasDerivAt_const b a).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id b))
  have h5 := (h3.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const a ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)))).deriv
  have h6 := (h4.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const b ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)))).deriv
  rw [h5, h6]
  simp only [map_zero, add_zero]
  exact hf.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp) _ _
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 f → deriv (fun x : ℝ => deriv (fun y : ℝ => f (x, y)) b) a = deriv (fun y : ℝ => deriv (fun x : ℝ => f (x, y)) a) b
